entries.label: China loves a vacuum
entries.summary: China sets international standards with less resistance than before.
entries.quote: Until last year, China had avoided talk of global leadership, but now China is setting international standards with less resistance than ever before.

entries.label: Accidents
entries.summary: Many flashpoints make a misstep into serious conflict possible.
entries.quote: It's impossible to ignore the risk of a major crisis today, because there are too many places where a misstep or misjudgment could provoke serious international conflict.

entries.label: Global tech cold war
entries.summary: Tensions over the internet and technology sharpen in 2018.
entries.quote: The latest wave of innovation takes place at a time of broader tensions within the internet and technology spaces that will play an important role in 2018.

entries.label: Mexico
entries.summary: NAFTA renegotiation and the July election shape Mexico's outlook.
entries.quote: This year will be a defining moment for Mexico's longer-term outlook, which will depend on the outcome of NAFTA renegotiation and the country's 1 July presidential election.

entries.label: US-Iran relations
entries.summary: Failure of the nuclear deal would start a dangerous new dynamic.
entries.quote: If the nuclear agreement fails, the world will enter a new and dangerous dynamic.

entries.label: The erosion of institutions
entries.summary: Trust in technocratic institutions falls across the developed world.
entries.quote: Across the developed world, popular trust in technocratic/bureaucratic institutions has declined steeply, in some instances as a result of direct political interference in their work.

entries.label: Protectionism 2.0
entries.summary: Governments turn to a more mercantilist economic competition.
entries.quote: Antiestablishment movements have forced policymakers to shift toward a more mercantilist approach to global economic competition. Walls are going up.

entries.label: United Kingdom
entries.summary: Brexit talks and domestic politics trouble the UK.
entries.quote: The United Kingdom's troubles will come from both acrimonious Brexit negotiations and difficult domestic politics.

entries.label: Identity politics in southern Asia
entries.summary: Identity politics threatens growing economies in southern Asia.
entries.quote: Southern Asia identity politics threatens the future of these increasingly prosperous regions, creating unexpected challenges for economic planners and foreign investors.

entries.label: Africa's security
entries.summary: Instability on Africa's periphery harms its success stories.
entries.quote: Negative spillover from Africa's unstable periphery will increasingly spoil the continent's success stories.

entries.quote: For 2018, the Trump White House promises a year of blazing one-day headlines, but almost nothing that moves the needle on policy.
